arc: conversation (one continuous take): hook question ×3 → reply → link-preview reveal → feature question → answer → fire reaction → payoff line

scenes.title: Messenger dark-mode thread: launch-video panic to link preview
scenes.summary: A black, dark-mode Facebook Messenger screen with 'Maya / Active now' in the header and blue accent icons. Internal beats: problem — three #303030 incoming bubbles 'Ok so we're launching on Tuesday 🚀', 'and I still don't have a launch video 😭', 'what's the best tool for making one??' each after typing dots; turn — you type and send 'say less' (thumbs-up morphs into a send arrow); reveal — 'genmotion.dev' sends as a blue bubble above a dark link-preview card ('AI Product Launch Video Generator'); feature — 'wait it writes the scenes itself??' / 'and exports a real MP4'; payoff — a 🔥 reaction pops on the card and 'ok I'm never opening After Effects again' lands, ending on a typing indicator.
scenes.build: Same engine as the Instagram and WhatsApp templates: a SCRIPT array laid out bottom-up where each slot eases open (12 frames, outCubic) ahead of a spring-scaled bubble, TYPING windows for the dots chip, and COMPOSE entries driving a hand-rolled ComposerInput caret; composer icons collapse via a shared typingUI factor. Tokens (M), Avatar, TypingDots, LinkPreview and ComposerInput are in components/messenger.tsx; SFX cues in project.json sit on each bubble's impact frame.
scenes.reuse: Use when the chat must read as Messenger or simply as a dark-mode iOS chat: swap the script, avatar, link card and reaction emoji. It is effectively the same scene as instagram-chat-video's with a different skin and no emoji-only reply, so prefer that one as the reference for the layout logic. Don't copy the GenMotion link card or Maya persona unless the video is about GenMotion.
